messages.subject: Application Timeout on iOS
parts:
A problem I've been running into with Shiny apps that I have created is that application closes prematurely on iOS when compared with PC browsers.  I will be using the app and it will grey out as would occur if the session timed out.  This appears to be unrelated to the application timeout that can be configured server-side.  Increasing that value works for PC browsers, but the timeouts occur regardless on iOS.

Any ideas on what may be causing this or how it may be fixed?
